name: Helio
description: A heliograph shutter: open, half open, shut — the whole vocabulary of a mirror.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @pick(polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%), polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 46%, 0 46%), polygon(0 54%, 100% 54%, 100% 100%, 0 100%)); clip-path: @pick(polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%), polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 46%, 0 46%), polygon(0 54%, 100% 54%, 100% 100%, 0 100%)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
